fusions.name: Buried Under Fur
fusions.desc: The pack piles its whole weight onto every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each of them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Lean Season Lunge
fusions.desc: A mauling bite that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 36%).

fusions.name: Sleep Off the Winter
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Nowhere Left to Run
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
